narrative.intro: Palmetto Gba has $324M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 14 awards and with an average award size of $23.2M. Obligations are down 14.8% year over year. The Department of Health and Human Services is the dominant buyer, accounting for $308M of obligations. Palmetto Gba’s largest market is Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers with $271M in obligations. Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services is the next market by value at $23.1M. Other active markets include Administration of Human Resource Programs at $17M and All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $12.4M. Two reported markets show $0 in obligations. Historical obligations show variation, with FY25 at $381M, FY24 at $264M, FY23 at $372M, FY22 at $265M, and FY21 at $351M. The Railroad Retirement Board is a smaller buyer with $16.2M in FY2026 to date. These figures reflect contract obligations for the fiscal year to date and summarize where federal spending for Palmetto Gba is concentrated this fiscal year.

sections.heading: How large is Palmetto Gba’s federal contracting activity this fiscal year?
sections.body: Palmetto Gba has $324M in obligations in FY2026 to date across 14 awards, with an average award size of $23.2M. Obligations are down 14.8% year over year. Historical fiscal-year obligations include FY25 at $381M and FY24 at $264M, showing year-to-year variation.

sections.heading: Who are the main buyers and what services does Palmetto Gba provide?
sections.body: The Department of Health and Human Services is the main buyer with $308M in obligations, and the Railroad Retirement Board is the next buyer with $16.2M. Palmetto Gba’s largest markets are Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $271M and Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services at $23.1M.

faq.q: How much does Palmetto Gba make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Palmetto Gba has $324M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Palmetto Gba’s FY2026 to date activity comes from 14 awards with an average award size of $23.2M, and obligations are down 14.8% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Palmetto Gba?
faq.a: The Department of Health and Human Services buys most from Palmetto Gba, with $308M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Railroad Retirement Board is the next buyer with $16.2M in obligations.

faq.q: What does Palmetto Gba sell to the government?
faq.a: Palmetto Gba sells health and insurance related services and supporting IT services to the federal government, led by Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $271M. Palmetto Gba also provides Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services at $23.1M, Administration of Human Resource Programs at $17M, and All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $12.4M.

faq.q: Which Palmetto Gba contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring contracts are listed among the provided figures. The available figures show obligations by fiscal year, top buying agencies, and top markets, but do not include an expiring-contracts table in the provided data.
